title: Chat Automation Gateway
description: A bridge between a LINE account and a Discord server that routes approved messages to an automation backend behind fail-closed authorization.

caseStudy.problem: I wanted a single service to receive messages from a LINE account and a Discord community and route them to an automation backend — without exposing an open relay anyone could abuse.
caseStudy.built: A bridge that ingests webhooks from LINE and Discord, matches each sender against a per-context allowlist, and forwards only approved messages to an automation backend over REST, with health and error reporting.
caseStudy.result: Unapproved senders are rejected by default (fail-closed) and the path stays observable, so automation runs for a small approved audience instead of an open public endpoint.
